objective: Find NEW rights-cleared pickleball footage beyond the exhausted DVIDS/Commons pool (HANDOFF_V3 external blocker 3) and register it as label-blind fresh holdout candidates.
whatWasBuilt: 6 new rights-cleared 60-second clips (181.08 MB total, 360 s of footage) committed under datasets/pickleball/fresh-candidates/ and registered with full provenance in datasets/pickleball/registry.json as role=fresh_candidate. 4 pickleball-relevant unknown-rights items registered as quarantined (not downloaded). No labels were created for any fresh candidate.

accepted.format: H.264 mp4, audio stripped, 1920x1080, 30 or 60 fps
accepted.license: CC BY 3.0 — each source's YouTube watch page license field reads verbatim: "Creative Commons Attribution license (reuse allowed)", which YouTube maps to CC BY 3.0 (https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2797468)
diversityAdded: night-time outdoor men's singles under lights (singles absent from existing corpus)
indoor gym doubles on portable net
accepted.visualVerification: One frame extracted from every trimmed clip and inspected: all six show live pickleball play (courts, paddles, ball in flight).

searchLog.result: The 16 pickleball videos already in datasets/corpus/sources.json are the complete DVIDS pickleball inventory; the broader queries returned paddlecraft/boating and generic fitness footage with no pickleball content. 0 new usable items — blocker 3 confirmed.
4 files returned, all 4 already registered in datasets/corpus (AFN Sigonella/Vicenza, Sasebo, Pickleball game.webm). 0 new.

2,403 hits, overwhelmingly municipal meeting/news TV. Pickleball-relevant gameplay items carry no licenseurl (rights unknown) or CC BY-NC-SA (noncommercial). 0 accepted; 4 registered as quarantined_not_downloaded / excluded_noncommercial.
API/proxy returned inconsistent non-JSON responses in several calls; retrievable results contained no pickleball motion footage. 0 accepted.
No downloadable pickleball video holdings found. 0 accepted.

searchLog.source: State/local government portals + stock portals (Pexels, Pixabay, Coverr)
searchLog.result: Pexels and Pixabay blocked scripted access with Cloudflare 403; Coverr API rejected access (Invalid API_KEY); no verifiable direct license path. 0 accepted — a platform 'free' label without a readable per-item license page was not treated as clearance.
6 relevant CC BY videos from 5 personal channels verified (license field read from each watch page) and accepted as 60 s trimmed clips.

honestNegatives: DVIDS is genuinely exhausted for pickleball: expanded base/event/year queries surfaced zero new pickleball videos.
Wikimedia Commons holds exactly the 4 pickleball videos already in the corpus.
No U.S. federal (NARA/LOC) pickleball motion footage was found, so no new public-domain-by-statute source exists.

The 6 accepted clips rely on uploader-declared CC BY 3.0. The license text was verified on each watch page and the channels are personal channels publishing self-recorded games, but uploader rights-holder authority is assessed from channel context, not independently confirmed. This caveat is recorded verbatim in each registry entry's restrictions.
The clips are 1080p re-encodes (libx264 crf20); one source is 1440p but only the 1080p stream was retrieved.
No stroke labels exist for any fresh candidate and none may be created before a future freeze (label-blind holdout policy).
remainsBlocked: Public-domain (rights-caveat-free) new footage remains unavailable: every federal/PD channel is exhausted, so any further growth needs either first-party consent-first collection (datasets/pickleball/collection_manifest.schema.json) or acceptance of uploader-declared CC licenses with the recorded caveat.
Fresh candidates are intentionally NOT imported into datasets/corpus (no split assignment, no mining) — that import belongs to the future holdout freeze owned by the integrator.
codeTouched: none — no package code modified, so no typecheck/test surface changed
